sovereign_country.strategic_role: 连接拉美市场的欧洲商贸桥梁、本地化仓配与数字游民签证

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Rope-Access Structural Glass Replacement on Supertall Skyscrapers

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Spain (national level; no sub-state tax distinction for this scope)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Continental European; codified, with strong mercantile registry doctrine)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el texto refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (LSC): Articles 12–22 (formalities), 22–28 (public deed and Commercial Registry filing), 33 (legal personality upon inscription), 62 (minimum SL capital of EUR 3,000), 102–107 (registered office), 175–179 (corporate resolutions), 209–213 (Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada). Complemented by Ley 14/2013 de apoyo a los emprendedores (CIRCE electronic incorporation), Real Decreto 1784/1996 (Reglamento del Registro Mercantil), and Ley 18/2022 Crea y Crece introducing the Sociedad de Formación Sucesiva.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central (Central Commercial Registry for name reservations) and the provincial Registro Mercantil of the registered office (local Commercial Registry), administered under the Colegio de Registradores de la Propiedad, Mercantiles y de Bienes Muebles de España; electronic submissions are channelled through CIRCE.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura pública de constitución (public deed of incorporation) executed before a Spanish notary and filed electronically for inscription in the provincial Registro Mercantil; simplified filing may be effected through CIRCE for a Sociedad Limitada de Formación Sucesiva.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Default SL minimum capital is EUR 3,000 (Art. 62 LSC), fully subscribed and fully paid-up at the moment of execution of the deed; payment must be evidenced by a Spanish bank deposit certificate (certificación bancaria) or, for in-kind contributions, by the statutory valuation report. Under Law 18/2022 Crea y Crece, an SL de formación sucesiva may be formed with a lower capital, subject to a legal reserve, prohibition on profit distribution and statutory liquidation constraints.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY] S.L. ADOPTED BY THE FOUNDING SHAREHOLDERS on [DATE]: 1. To ratify the subscription of the entire share capital of EUR 3,000 by unanimous allocation of quotas and to approve the deed of incorporation and the bylaws of the Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada under the Spanish Capital Companies Act. 2. To declare the company's registered office at [ADDRESS]. 3. To appoint [NAME] as the sole Managing Director/Administrador and [NAME] as Secretary, with full corporate representation. 4. To authorize the execution of the public deed before the Notary, the Commercial Registry inscription, the provisional NIF application, and the opening of a corporate bank account.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for the Corporate Name Certificate – Certificado Negativo de Denominación Social
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central, applied via the CIRCE electronic portal or directly through the official registry telematic channel
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the standardised request on Form Denominación with at least three proposed corporate names in order of preference. The Central Commercial Registry verifies that no identical or confusingly similar company name is reserved or registered under Spanish or EU law. Upon a positive screening, it issues the negative certification valid for three months, renewable for a further three months. The certificate must be presented later to the Notary; CIRCE delivers it electronically.
required_dossiers: Completed application form for negative name certification
Valid passport / DNI / NIE of each founding shareholder
List of three to five proposed corporate names in preferential order
Power of attorney, if an intermediary files the request on behalf of founders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is refused for identity, similarity or reserved-name conflicts (Art. 407, RD 1784/1996), the applicant may immediately re-file with alternative names; where inaction occurs beyond the legal term, a written reminder (requerimiento) may be submitted and the request re-presented with corrected name priorities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Public Deed of Incorporation before a Spanish Notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría (Notary Public) of the municipality where the registered office is located; the notary may be designated through CIRCE for accelerated incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: All founding shareholders must attend personally or through a duly authorised proxy. The Notary verifies legal capacity, receipt of the valid name certificate, compliance of the draft bylaws (estatutos) with Arts. 22 and 209–213 LSC, and evidence of capital payment (bank deposit certificate or in-kind valuation report). The deed is read aloud and signed by all shareholders. The Notary simultaneously applies for the provisional NIF/CIF and issues certified first copies.
required_dossiers: Valid certificado negativo de denominación social
Draft estatutos satisfying mandatory minimum content requirements
Bank deposit certificate evidencing full payment of EUR 3,000, or court-appointed expert valuation for in-kind assets
Valid DNI/NIE and tax residence evidence of each founding shareholder
Capital payment receipt and, where relevant, inventory of in-kind contributions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Notary identifies defects, the parties may remedy the same session by amending the draft or may execute a supplementary public deed (escritura complementaria); if tariff objections arise, the fee is governed by the official notarial arancel and a complaint may be lodged with the respective Colegio Notarial.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Inscription and BORME Publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province of the registered office, with external coordination by the Registro Mercantil Central and publication in the Boletín Oficial del Registro Mercantil (BORME)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month following execution of the deed, the certified first copy of the escritura de constitución is presented for inscription at the Provincial Commercial Registry. The Registrar verifies formal and material legality, confirms payment of the registry canon, and inscribes the company, thereby constituting its legal personality (Art. 33 LSC). The registry instruction is then automatically published in BORME.
required_dossiers: First authentic copy of the public deed of incorporation
Proof of payment of the Commercial Registry canon
Copy of provisional NIF/CIF issued by the Notary
DNI/NIE of the appointed statutory representative
Registration request fee form and self-declaration of affiliation code where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar files down the inscription, the company may correct and re-present the deed voluntarily; if the refusal persists, the applicant may lodge a recurso gubernativo before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública and subsequently a judicial appeal, with pleadings adjusted to the grounds of refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive Taxpayer Identification, Census Registration and IAE Declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), Provincial Delegation of the corporate tax domicile; electronic filing through the Sede Electrónica with digital certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month after Commercial Registry inscription, file Form 036 to obtain the definitive NIF/CIF, update the Censo de empresarios, profesionales y retenedores, and declare the alta in the Impuesto sobre Actividades Económicas (IAE) using the epígrafe covering the intended facade/construction activity. The company may also use the same declaration to request enrolment in the VAT register and, if applicable, the registration of the legal representative.
required_dossiers: Signed Form 036/037 electronic model
Certificate of Commercial Registry inscription
Provisional NIF/CIF assigned by the Notary
DNI/NIE of the statutory representative
Supporting documents for the registered office tax address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In the event of refusal or observations, the company may submit a rectification of the census declaration (declaración censal de rectificación) under the General Tax Law; if AEAT remains silent beyond the legal deadline, an official Certificado de Situación Censal may be requested to attest registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer Registration with Social Security and Occupational Risk-Prevention Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS), provincial administration; workplace opening communicated to the Autoridad Laboral of the Autonomous Community, transmitted via the RED/SILTRA system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The company registers as employer with TGSS and obtains the código de cuenta de cotización (CCC). In parallel, the company must adopt a written occupational risk-prevention arrangement, contract a prevention service (servicio de prevención ajeno) for high-altitude work, and file the comunicación de apertura del centro de trabajo together with the Plan de Seguridad y Salud required by Royal Decree 1627/1997 before starting construction operations.
required_dossiers: Employer registration form TA.7
Commercial Registry inscription certificate
DNI/NIE of the legal representative
Risk assessment and occupational safety plan (Plan de Seguridad y Salud)
Prevention service contract or own prevention organisation declaration
Collective bargaining agreement code (CNAE/CONVENIO)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RED system reports inconsistencies in identification or address, corrections must be filed electronically within ten days with the Commercial Registry certificate; a refusal by the labor authority concerning the safety plan may be cured by submitting an amended Plan de Seguridad y Salud and applying for a new acknowledgment of workplace opening.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Consejería competente en materia de Industria of the Autonomous Community (e.g., Dirección General de Industria, Energía y Minas) for industrial equipment and high-altitude work installations, joined by the municipal planning authority (Ayuntamiento) for the municipal activity and construction licences.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de actividad/apertura del Ayuntamiento (municipal activity permit) and Licencia de obras mayor for facade replacement works; the contracting/access specialist must also be registered in the Registro de Empresas Acreditadas (REA) under LEY 32/2006 to act as a subcontractor with recourse to verified prevention resources.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico (MITERD) together with the Autonomous Community Directorate-General for Environmental Quality; municipal environmental services act as enforcement and licensing agent for minor works.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from full EIA under Law 21/2013; subject to simplified environmental assessment (evaluación de impacto ambiental simplificada) only when works affect protected natural areas or when Annex II threshold screening is triggered; otherwise only a municipal environmental licence/comunicación ambiental is required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge to municipal sewer must respect municipal by-laws (COD below 1,000 mg/l if any process water arises); solvent-based sealants must comply with Royal Decree 117/2003 (VOC limits) and Royal Decree 1367/2007 (noise limits); glass and construction debris, goods code 17 02 02, must be delivered to an authorised waste manager under Law 7/2022 on waste and with a numbered DTA; dust suppression measures must be implemented in accordance with the applicable municipal ordinance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety certification under Royal Decree 2267/2004 or Technical Building Code DB-SI for storage and workshop areas; structural load-certification of anchorages, mast climbers and gondola fixing points by a competent technical architect; submission of the Plan de Seguridad y Salud and the Apertura de Centro de Trabajo to the provincial labor authority before operation; civil-defense notification to the municipality where high-altitude work over public thoroughfares requires cordoning or rescue readiness; rope-access technicians to hold internationally recognised IRATA-level certification or equivalent and a valid medical fitness certificate for work at height.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) – Sede Electrónica: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es; VAT operating portal for SII reporting, Models 036/037 and NIF issuance; customs deliverables via the Customs and Excise Department (Departamento de Aduanas e Impuestos Especiales).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: incorporate the SL by notarial deed, execute commencement certificate (Certificación de inicio de actividad) and register with the Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil) to obtain provisional NIF. Step 2: file Modelo 036/037 (Censo de empresarios, profesionales y retenedores) with AEAT within one month of commencement to obtain the definitive NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal) and be assigned a CNAE 4390 nominal activity code; foreign non-resident contractors without a Spanish establishment apply for a non-resident NIF (new unified NIF for foreign entities) and must appoint a Spanish fiscal representative before invoicing; a Spanish VAT identification number is granted upon Modelo 036 completion, and the SL is integrated into the Intra-Community Operators Register (ROI) for cross-border intra-EU supplies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or pass-through election exists under Spanish law; an SL is compulsorily taxed under Impuesto sobre Sociedades (Corporate Income Tax) at the general 25% rate, subject to the statutory elections of (i) Special Joint-Taxation Regime for groups satisfying 70%+ threshold and 100% for all-consolidation elections, (ii) Special Reorganisation Neutrality Regime (Tax Merger Directive transposition) with deferral elections, (iii) Successive instalment payment options, (iv) R&D tax credit monetisation option within 15-year window, and (v) the international transparency (CFC) and branch exemption elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA – Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido (European VAT subject to Council Directive 2006/112/EC)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general annual turnover de-minimis threshold: any habitual supply of taxable goods or services in Spanish territory triggers mandatory registration (Modelo 036) from the first taxable act; for intra-EU distance sales of goods, the applicable harmonised threshold is EUR 10,000 aggregated across all EU Member States, above which Spanish VAT registration becomes mandatory; non-established foreign suppliers without a fixed establishment must register directly in Spain for supplies of services/goods located in Spain, barring B2B reverse-charge treatment.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory B2B e-invoicing under the 'Crea y Crece' framework (Ley 18/2022) is being phased from 2025 through Verifactura, requiring digital stamping, structured electronic interchange, the public-sector variant using Facturae and FACe; large enterprises over EUR 8 million annual turnover are already subject to the Immediate Supply of Information (SII) regime, which requires the real-time transmission to AEAT of invoice issue and received invoice data within 4 calendar days (extended to 8 days for in-month volume aggregation); all taxpayers must preserve SSTTI (Sistema Suministro Electrónico de Datos Tributarios) compliant records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods to third countries/non-EU territories qualify for 0% Spanish VAT only if the goods leave the EU territory within 90 days of dispatch and the exporter retains the accepted SAD/DEX export declaration and transport evidence (Article 21, Spanish VAT Law 37/1992); the commercial services of this rope-access facade business are governed by the place-of-supply rule for immovable property, so glass replacement services performed on buildings physically situated in Spain are Spanish-sited and taxable at 21%, while services performed on non-EU immovables are outside the scope of Spanish VAT (0% equivalent); intra-EU B2B supplies by a Spanish-registered SL are zero-rated under the reverse-charge mechanism conditional on recording in the ROI register, inclusion in the recapitulative EC Sales List (Modelo 349), and client possession of a valid EU VAT ID; documentary evidence includes the DUA/SIE customs record, logistic boarding documents, and the contractual construction-site certificate proving the property location.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA - Documento Único Administrativo / SIE electronic record) with 90-day proof of physical departure from the EU
Transport evidence: Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, CMR (international road consignment) or rail consignment note naming the exporter/consignee
Commercial invoice, packing list and origin certificates (EUR.1/ATR where applicable)
Proof of payment or Inward Remittance Certificate demonstrating the full foreign-customer remittance
Contract, certificate of completion on site, and any customs seals/transit declarations supporting the specific facade installation locus
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Spanish exchange control rules require export proceeds to be brought into Spain within a 4-month (c.120-day) period from shipment; the platform-level cap of 180 days must be read with this stricter statutory deadline. Substantiation failure exposes the SL to immediate VAT reinstatement by AEAT plus late-payment interest (5% per month compounded up to 20%), penalties under Ley General Tributaria of 50%-150% of the tax amount for concealment, loss of the export exemption for up to 12 months on repeated infraction, and where the evaded VAT exceeds EUR 120,000 criminal liability under the Código Penal for tax fraud carrying 2-6 years imprisonment together with disqualification from public contracts and subsidies.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.jurisdiction_glossary_notes: All references to 'export' in the context of services are construed under the Spanish VAT place-of-supply regime for immovable-property services; the comparative zero-rate does not apply to construction-type facade services performed on structures located in Spain — such services bear the standard 21% IVA unless rendered to a foreign business under reverse-charge (B2B) mechanisms.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), acting as central bank, macroprudential and AML supervisor, together with the Ministry of Economy's Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones (DGCOMINT), which administers the Foreign Investment Register and trade-policy declarations for Spain.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full capital and current account convertibility applies as Spain is a Eurozone member. The euro is freely convertible and no exchange-control authorisation is required for shareholder loans, equity injections, dividends, or trade payments. Profit remittance to non-resident shareholders is unrestricted and limited only by Spanish corporate legal solvency tests and any applicable treaty withholding tax. The sole administrative hurdles are declarative: (i) Bank of Spain Circular 4/2012 requires resident banks to report to the Foreign Transactions Register any resident-non-resident payment or receipt equal to or exceeding EUR 50,000; and (ii) Law 18/2022 on foreign investments requires an ex-post declaration to DGCOMINT for non-EU/EFTA acquisitions of Spanish SL shares where the invested amount exceeds EUR 1,000,000 or the investor is domiciled in a non-cooperative jurisdiction. Rope-access facade activities do not fall into the critical-infrastructure or public-order sectors formerly prior-notified under Royal Decree-Law 8/2020, so only ex-post filing applies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Spain imposes no statutory surrender or mandatory conversion ratio on export receipts or cross-border service revenue. The SL may retain 100% of proceeds in EUR or any foreign currency and may maintain bank accounts outside Spain without exchange-control approval. Reporting duties are limited to: (i) the bank's statistical declaration to Banco de España for any transaction equal to or exceeding EUR 50,000; (ii) the SL's annual tax disclosure of foreign income and balance-sheet receivables in Modelo 200; and (iii) for large companies only, quarterly T-1 statistical forms. Pure cross-border services exports require no Intrastat or customs DUAs; however, invoice and contract documentation must be retained for the bank's Circular 4/2012 reporting.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.fx_control_regime_summary: No exchange controls; declarative regime only; full euro convertibility; statutory reporting thresholds of EUR 50,000 per transaction to Banco de España.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_and_regulator_contact: Banco de España, Alcalá 48, 28014 Madrid; DGCOMINT, Paseo de la Castellana 162, 28046 Madrid; both accessible via online filing portals for ex-post declarations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Cuenta de Depósito y Avales)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-High for fee-based EUR collections and PSD2-passported payment initiation, but Low for core treasury needs. Third-country digital EMIs (UK or non-EEA post-Brexit entities) cannot passport into Spain under Law 21/2011 and require a Spanish authorised entity or a credit-institution sponsor; even then, they cannot issue bank guarantees or avales, which are indispensable for facade subcontracting under Law 32/2006. Recommended architecture: Tier-1 Spanish bank for operational and escrow accounts plus an EU-passported EMI for rapid onboarding and cross-border conversion in a segregated treasury overlay.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is technically permitted under Law 10/2010 when a qualified electronic signature or home-notarised video identification technique homologated by Bank of Spain is used, but in practice the systemically relevant Spanish banks require an in-person interview with the legal representative (administrador solidario) or a formally appointed apoderado. Non-EU-resident directors must appear with: (i) the apostilled and sworn-translated (traductor jurado) deed of incorporation and powers; (ii) NIF certificate for the SL and NIE for the individual; (iii) valid passport; and (iv) proof of address. Where a local representative is offered, a notarised power of attorney specifically covering bank account opening, signature authority and AML questionnaire sign-off must be granted and presented to the branch. Some banks permit the initial appointment by web-meeting with live geolocation if originals are forwarded by courier, but the compliance interview remains mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Structuring red flag: opaque multi-layer offshore shareholding and non-EU ultimate beneficial owners.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver: (i) notarised and apostilled full chain-of-title for the group; (ii) the Spanish Registro de Titularidad Real UBO extract or sworn declaration (Modelo TE-UBO) listing every natural-person UBO; (iii) consolidated auditor's accounts; (iv) a no-litigation corporate standing report; and (v) a rational memo proving operating substance (headcount, premises, plant and contracts).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sector-specific red flag: construction subcontracting chains and wage-payment flows that may alert AML systems to social-security evasion or cash-wage disbursement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide the statutory Libro de Subcontratación, TC1/TC2 social-security proof of payments and IRPF Modelo 111 withholdings, signed contractor contracts, occupational-risk and rope-access certifications, plus 12 months of bank statements demonstrating that 95% of outflows follow allowed rails (SEPA, MT103, payroll) with no cash withdrawals.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction red flag: early or recurring inward remittances from high-risk jurisdictions or payments without clearly referenced underlying contract.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Furnish the signed facade-works contract with value date and scope, proforma invoices, project certificates if goods are involved, the SWIFT purpose reference (APORTACION-SOCIO or TRADE-PAY-ZLE), original source-of-wealth bank statements for the remitting entity, and confirmation that all parties appear on a favourable OFAC/EU sanctions screening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Reputational red flag: perceived shell entity (no local substance) for the Spanish SL.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Present a Spanish lease or renewable office/workshop contract, water and power bills in the SL's name, payroll of at least two operative technicians, equipment ownership or leasing invoices, a tax-residence certificate and the CVs of the responsible technical directors, evidencing a real, functioning business.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.ubs_and_regulatory_notes: All banks will require the SL to complete the Registro de Titularidad Real declaration, provide the NIF certificate and specify the economic activity code (CNAE 4390). Non-resident shareholders' identification documents must be notarised and apostilled; a sworn translation to Spanish is mandatory for anything not issued in Spanish, English, French, Italian or Portuguese.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Recommended routing: SWIFT MT103 (or SEPA Direct Credit) from the shareholder's bank to the SL's operative account at Banco Santander, BBVA, CaixaBank or Banco de Sabadell. For EUR payments execute through Target2; for non-EUR use the correspondent rails of the receiving Spanish bank. The wire instruction must include the reference 'APORTACION-SOCIO' (capital contribution) in the remittance information field and the beneficiary's 22-digit IBAN. Compliance requires: (i) for amounts equal to or exceeding EUR 50,000, the receiving bank triggers Circular 4/2012 statistical reporting; (ii) if the shareholder is a non-EU/EFTA resident and the contribution exceeds EUR 1,000,000, an ex-post foreign-investment declaration must be filed with DGCOMINT within one month; (iii) the bank will demand the capital-increase deed and source-of-funds evidence (shareholder's bank statements, annual accounts, tax returns). Capital contributions are exempt from Spanish stamp duty but must be evidenced by a public deed where the law requires notarisation for third-party effectiveness.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails for trade settlements are: (i) SEPA Instant Credit for eurozone suppliers; (ii) SWIFT MT103 for non-EUR or third-country payments with structured remittance information including invoice number, contract number, and Incoterms; (iii) Commercial Documentary Letters of Credit for imports of facade glass and subframe systems governed by UCP 600, issued via the Spanish bank and advised through the supplier's banker; (iv) bank guarantees (avales) and standby letters of credit to main contractors in the supertall building segment; and (v) reverse-factoring or supply-chain finance programmes. Any outbound remittance equal to or exceeding EUR 50,000 to a non-resident is subject to the Bank of Spain statistical declaration; no prior licence is required. FX can be executed spot at the bank's fixing, and FX spread can be reduced by netting offset invoices in the same currency.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD forwards (physical settlement) under an ISDA Master Agreement or ISDA 1992/2002 plus CSA
Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) on restricted-convertibility currencies such as ARS, MXN, and BRL through a Bank of Spain authorised credit institution
FX swaps (swap points) on EUR/USD and EUR/Latam currency pairs for temporary liquidity management
European-style FX options (knock-in and knock-out) purchased from an investment-grade counterparty
Cross-currency swaps for long-term non-EUR funding if approved by the bank's credit committee
EMIR-compliant cleared plain-vanilla derivatives subject to mandatory margining where the SL or the bank exceeds clearing thresholds
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_purpose_code_and_regulatory_note: For bank onboarding, consistently classify all capital contributions as 'Aportación de Socios' in the company records and in the SWIFT reference. Do not commingle operational trade payments with shareholder loans. Maintain a separate intercompany current account ledger to support audit and Bank of Spain statistical reviews.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 4 months after financial year-end (e.g., 30 April for 31 December year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of 1,000-3,000 EUR; repeated non-filing may trigger administrative dissolution proceedings

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Annual turnover exceeding 2,500,000 EUR, total assets exceeding 2,500,000 EUR, or average number of employees exceeding 50
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP (Pyme GAAP for qualifying entities or full standards where applicable)

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual review and update of beneficial ownership information in the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate for newly created entities under Law 28/2022 during the first two tax periods; R&D and innovation tax credits up to 42% under Article 35 LIS; patent box regime allowing 50% reduction on qualifying IP income; 70% or 90% deduction on income from intangible assets; reserve for investments in the Canary Islands Special Zone (ZEC) is not applicable unless the entity is physically established and registered in the ZEC; no general notional interest deduction applies. Only actual R&D activities in high-altitude rope-access safety software or facade material innovation would qualify with proper technical certification.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 200 (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) filed via the Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) electronic registration system (www.agenciatributaria.es), with mandatory electronic filing for all corporate taxpayers. XML upload or online web form.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 25 calendar days following the six-month post-fiscal-year-end period. For fiscal years ending 31 December: due between 1 July and 25 July of the following tax year. Fiscal year-end may differ for non-resident taxpayers if the parent's fiscal year is different, but the return must cover a 12-month period unless otherwise approved.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NIF (CIF/NIF) of the Spanish tax-resident entity (SL). Also the legal form code, registered address, and tax domicile.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Spanish SL itself files under its own NIF. Non-resident entities without a permanent establishment do not file Modelo 200; they file Modelo 210 for non-resident income tax. If a PE exists, the PE files Modelo 200 using a local NIF for the PE.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net accounting result before corporation tax, calculated under Spanish GAAP (Plan General Contable). Include all revenue from high-altitude rope-access facade contracts, subcontracting costs, safety equipment depreciation, and personnel costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident PE, only income attributable to the PE in Spain is reported. The accounting must be separate or clearly identify the PE's operations. Direct and indirect costs incurred abroad for facade contracts are allocated if documented.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Permanent and temporary adjustments to accounting result: non-deductible provisions, penalties, fines, disallowed expenses (e.g., bribes, non-justified expenses), inventory revaluations, and timing differences for long-term contracts recognised on a percentage-of-completion basis.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PE may deduct properly allocated expenses of the head office only if the taxpayer files Form 200 with sufficient evidence. Transfer pricing adjustments under Article 16 LIS are entered here where intercompany services have been overcharged.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable base (Base imponible) after applying the 50% offset limitation on prior-year tax losses from the most recent 5 years and the 1 million euro annual offset cap. No additional cap for new companies unless corrected.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A PE must compute its own taxable base. Losses of other non-resident activities of the same taxpayer outside Spain cannot be offset against PE profits. The 5-year carryforward applies only to positive Spanish PE tax basis.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable tax rate: general 25%, reduced 15% for new SL entities (first tax year with activity and following one), or special regimes for cooperatives etc. The rate applies to the taxable base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the SL or PE is a party to a tax treaty, the treaty rate may be applied via treaty tie-breaker clauses only for determining the applicable rate under Spanish law. The general 25% rate applies unless a specific treaty article or internal rule provides otherwise.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions and tax credits: double international taxation credit (Box 00800), double domestic taxation credit, R&D deduction (Box 00802), and vocational training and job creation deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Double international taxation relief is available for tax paid abroad by the Spanish entity on foreign-source income. If the facade company pays taxes in Latin American countries on a branch or PE, a credit up to the Spanish tax on that income is available under Art. 31 LIS. Non-resident shareholders do not enter credits here.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total tax liability (Cuota íntegra) and net tax liability (Cuota líquida) after applying all tax credits, withheld taxes, and quarterly payments on account.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Prepayments made by the PE under Modelo 202 (quarterly installments) are credited. For a PE, the withholding tax on Spanish-source payments received (e.g., interest) is credited against the PE's tax liability. If the PE has no Spanish withholding income, no credit arises. If the head office is in a treaty country, the PE does not get a treaty credit on its own; the head office may apply foreign tax credit in its residence jurisdiction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount payable or refundable (Cuota resultante) after offsetting prepayments, credits, and withholdings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Refunds are made only to a Spanish bank account. Non-resident taxpayers must provide a local account or use the AEAT third-party payment system. If the PE is closed, the head office must apply for a refund through its Spanish representation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing within 3 months after deadline: 5% surcharge plus late interest; 3-6 months: 10%; 6-12 months: 15%; over 12 months: 20% plus late interest. Additionally, minimum penalty of EUR 1,000 for filing after formal AEAT notice. Penalties for deficient filing start at EUR 200 per form. Severe non-filing may trigger criminal sanctions if tax loss exceeds EUR 120,000.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a reduced DTA withholding rate on dividends, the non-resident shareholder must submit Form 210 (Non-Resident Income Tax return) within one month of the dividend payment date. The shareholder must attach a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the resident country's tax authority, stating residence for the relevant calendar year, and a statement of beneficial ownership. For EU/EEA Parent-Subsidiary Directive relief, the parent must hold a minimum 5% direct shareholding for at least one uninterrupted year; the TRC must be submitted to the Spanish paying entity before or at the time of payment to allow application of the exemption or 0% withholding. For treaty relief, use the protocol under the applicable DTA: complete Form 210, attach the TRC, the dividend distribution certificate, and Form 211/212 where applicable. If the reduced rate is not applied at source, the shareholder may claim a refund by submitting Form 210 within the 4-year statute of limitations.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: interest 19% (new rate from 2023; 24% applied to interest on late payments and shareholder lending without risk); royalties 24% (19% if EU/EEA resident and Directive 2003/49/EC applies, subject to economic substance test). Treaty rates vary: Spain-US DTA: interest and royalties generally 0% for financial institutions, 10% for royalties, 5% for industrial property royalties; Spain-UK DTA: 10% on royalties, 0% on interest; Spain-Germany DTA: 10% on royalties, 0% on interest; Spain-China DTA: 10% interest, 10% royalties. For facade-related equipment leases, royalties for intellectual property are typically treated as royalty if paid as consideration for use of copyrights, designs, or know-how. Site-specific rope-access methodology know-how may be royalty if separately invoiced. Interest on intercompany loans must be arm's length and not treated as hidden equity distribution under thin capitalisation rules (Art. 16.5 LIS) if subject to excessive leverage.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 1,000,000 total annual related-party transactions (chapter 1) and EUR 1,000,000 taxable net turnover. If related-party transactions exceed EUR 1,000,000, the taxpayer must keep contemporaneous Master File and Local File. Spanish law also requires documentation for any related-party transaction if the counterparty is resident in a tax haven, regardless of amount. For taxpayers subject to Modelo 200, documentation must be available upon request of AEAT; failure to produce it triggers penalties under Article 18.14 LIS. In addition, the Spanish Tax Agency may request that the taxpayer file Form 232 (Informative Tax Return of Related-Party Transactions) annually whenever the aggregate amount of related-party operations exceeds EUR 250,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain applies substance requirements derived from EU Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive (ATAD) and Spanish anti-abuse rules (Art. 15 and 16 LIS). A Spanish SL performing high-altitude rope-access facade work must have real productive capacity: employees, contracts, equipment, and management decisions in Spain. An entity with no local employees or business activity may be recharacterised as a conduit, and withholding taxes or transfer pricing adjustments may be imposed. Spain's CFC rules (Art. 100-102 LIS) apply to non-resident subsidiaries in low-tax jurisdictions (effective tax below 75% of Spanish tax) if they earn passive income such as royalties, interest, and service income. ESR-style substance requirements are not self-standing in Spain but are integrated into the general anti-abuse framework, especially in applying DTA benefits and the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsifying Modelo 200, omitting high-altitude facade project revenue, issuing false invoices for subcontracts or equipment rentals that are nonexistent, or intentionally undervaluing intercompany services with a tax loss exceeding EUR 120,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment of 2 to 6 years, fine of 2 to 6 times the defrauded amount (Art. 305 Penal Code). Loss of public subsidies and tax incentives, and civil liability for the tax debt plus late interest. Administrative penalty of 50% to 100% of the tax evaded.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, legal representatives, or shadow directors who order or cooperate in the evasion are criminally liable under Art. 305. Administrative derivative liability under Art. 42 LGT allows the Spanish Tax Agency to seize personal assets if the corporate assets are insufficient. Travel bans and imprisonment may be imposed as precautionary measures. Veil-piercing (levantamiento del velo) is available where the corporate form is a mere facade.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Spanish S.L. with no office, employees, bank account or real business activity solely to invoice facade services to other countries or to channel dividends out of Spain, while the actual activity is performed by a foreign group company. Also, neglecting to hold annual general meetings, fulfil accounting books, or pay corporate taxes based on a fabricated low revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative recharacterisation and full taxation of actual income, plus late interest and penalties up to 50% of the omitted tax. In case of fraud, criminal proceedings. The Income Tax Administration may also impose a penalty of EUR 1,000 to EUR 5,000 for each material omission in corporate books. Additionally, denial of any treaty benefits if the entity fails economic substance requirements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be held personally liable for corporate tax debts under Art. 43.1 LGT when they fail to wind up the company or knowingly continue a shell with no activity. They may face administrative fines and in criminal cases incarceration. Spanish courts may apply veil-piercing to order shareholders to pay the corporation's debts. Travel bans are possible under criminal seizure provisions if the amount outstanding exceeds EUR 1 million.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML Failures (Unless subject to AML regulation, only criminal charges if involved in illegal proceeds)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately ignoring source of funds for large contract advances, accepting cash payments above EUR 100,000 without identifying ultimate beneficial owner, or moving project proceeds through territories with high-risk AML deficiencies (CRS non-compliant) to avoid tax traceability.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal money laundering under Art. 301 Penal Code: imprisonment of 6 months to 6 years and fine of 3 times the laundered value. Administrative sanctions under Anti-Money Laundering Law 10/2010 if the entity is a commissioned agent or operates in a high-risk sector: fines up to EUR 5,000,000. Non-regulated rope-access facade contractors are not automatically subject to AML but are subject to anti-fraud laws and asset traceability rules under Spanish tax law. If the entity fails to maintain accounting records that permit determination of the tax base, a fixed penalty of EUR 1,000 to EUR 2,000 plus proportional surcharges apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally criminally liable for money laundering if they know or intentionally ignore the illegal origin of funds. Individual fines and imprisonment up to 6 years. Travel bans and asset embargoes may be ordered. The corporate veil can be lifted to recover property. Directors also face disqualification from holding public contracts or EU funding.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Non-Filing or Gross Under-Filing of Modelo 200
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Repeated failure to file Modelo 200 for two consecutive years, or filing a return with declared revenue equal to zero while corporate bank accounts show significant inflows for facade services, without reasonable explanation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty for non-filing: 20% of the tax liability plus late interest; minimum penalty of EUR 1,000. If the non-filing is intentional to evade tax above EUR 120,000, imprisonment as per Art. 305. Additionally, the Tax Agency can estimate the tax base by indirect assessment using bank deposits, expenditure indicators, and gross margin ratios.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Art. 42.2 LGT imposes joint and several liability on directors who caused the tax debt by negligent management. This attaches to their personal assets. If the company is dissolved without paying tax, directors are liable for debts up to the liquidation quota. Travel bans are not automatic in administrative matters but may be ordered by the court in criminal proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare or submit the mandatory Local File / Master File when related-party transactions exceed EUR 1,000,000, or submitting documentation that is materially inaccurate or manifestly incomplete. This includes not justifying the arm's length remuneration of subcontractor margins for rope-access facade services.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Art. 18.14 LIS: fine of 15% of the amount of the related-party transaction for which documentation is missing. If income is adjusted, the additional tax deficiency is assessed with penalties up to 50% of the tax (if documentation is lacking, a 15% fine on the entire transaction amount applies even before tax adjustment). Late interest applies from the end of the voluntary payment period.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who order or negligently permit the failure to document transfer pricing may be held jointly liable under Art. 43.1 LGT. In cases where the missing documentation is used to hide true taxable presence, criminal tax evasion charges may be brought against the director. Travel bans may arise in fraud investigations, and personal seizure of assets is possible when tax debt is substantial.
